Historical development of hunting weapons and ammunition, types of weapons, classification. (allowance 0/3)
Firearms – basic structure and main parts of a weapon. (allowance 0/3)

Hunting ammunition - development, classification, definition of hunting ammunition. Correct selection of suitable hunting ammunition with regard to caliber and bullet design for hunting selected game species. (allowance 0/3)
Hunting ballistics – internal, transitional, external and terminal ballistics. Focused on wound ballistics and the effects of hunting bullets. (allowance 0/3)
Rules for safe handling of hunting weapons. (allowance 0/3)
Legislation – prohibited methods of hunting (Hunting Act), legislative aspects of possession, carrying and use of hunting weapons (Firearms and Ammunition Act). (allowance 0/3)
Reloading of hunting ammunition – legislative framework for reloading ammunition, reloading equipment and a detailed description of the entire reloading process. (allowance 0/3)

Observation and shooting optics and equipment – ​​development of observation and aiming techniques, description of current aiming and observation devices in the context of hunting efficiency and applicable legislation. (allowance 0/3)

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The course aims to present students with a comprehensive set of information about the use of hunting weapons as the most common method of controlling game populations.
